description_en: Lists the resources configured for an instance

name: ListInstanceResources

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can obtain the instance ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2411819.html operation
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The category of the resource. Valid values:

DataManagement

Engine

Monitor
parameters.help_zh:
资源类别

DataManagement

Engine

Monitor
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The group of the resource.

If `Category` is `DataManagement`, valid values are:

storage

modelpipeline

datastorage

modeltrain

If `Category` is `Engine`, valid values are:

feature

predict

recall

recengine

If `Category` is `Monitor`, valid values are:

logs

logsback

coldstart

deploy
